- [qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

- [youhuabanben_c1-st10000.safetensors](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/xptianshi/youhuabanben)

**upscale_models**

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── krea2_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── qwen_image_vae.safetensors
│   └── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── m87_lora_v1.safetensors
│   │   └── realism_engine_krea2_v3.1.safetensors
│   │   └── youhuabanben_c1-st10000.safetensors
│   └── 📂 upscale_models/
│       └── 4xFFHQDAT.pth
``` 


## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)


## Plugin Requirements
- Krea Moodboards https://github.com/Andro-Meta/ComfyUI-Krea-Moodboards
- Krea2 Harness https://github.com/ANe5s/ComfyUI-Krea2-Harness

nodes.title: Model and Usage Guide
widgets_values:
# Krea 2 Turbo Text-to-Image

## Workflow

Main Prompt → Stage 1 prompt refinement → Stage 2 moodboard style compilation → Krea 2 Turbo sampling → Save Image. The moodboard browser's positive content contributes to the final prompt, and its negative content is connected to the negative conditioning node.

## How to use

1. Edit「Krea2 Prompt」.
2. Choose a moodboard in「Krea Moodboard Visual Browser」.
3. Set the aspect ratio and target megapixels in「Krea2 Resolution Selector」.
4. Use the LoRA Switch to enable or bypass the workflow's LoRA branch. You can reselect model files to match your local installation.
5. Adjust the target size with「Second-Pass Resolution Scale」.
6. Queue the workflow.

## Before running

- Diffusion model: a Krea 2 Turbo checkpoint in ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/.
- Text encoder: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors.
- VAE: ComfyUI/models/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors.
- LoRAs referenced by the workflow are stored in ComfyUI/models/loras/.
- Install ComfyUI-Krea2-Harness and a moodboard node package that provides Krea Moodboard Visual Browser.

If a loader shows a missing model, select a compatible file installed on your machine.

## Second pass and upscaling

After the first render, this workflow upscales and resizes the image, encodes it with the VAE, runs a second sampling pass, then decodes and saves the result. Adjust the target size with Second-Pass Resolution Scale. Choose the upscaler in Load Upscale Model; the example uses 4xFFHQDAT.
